acceptance.criterion: pass requires every timing-bearing stage that ran to meet setup and hold with zero violating paths; place-and-route additionally requires finite reported timing and zero DRC, antenna, max-slew, max-capacitance and max-fanout violations
acceptance.note: status is the engineering result, not whether the script finished; see flow_completed for that

design.cells_basis: place_and_route.metrics.standard_cell_count: routed netlist after timing repair and clock-tree synthesis, buffers included
design.closed_basis: true only when place-and-route ran, the routed netlist carries zero max-slew, max-cap and max-fanout violations, and the engineering verdict is pass: setup and hold met with zero violating paths, zero DRC, zero antenna violations at the target period
design.description: ad-hoc block supplied on the command line

git.dirty_basis: a tracked file modified or an untracked file outside results/; untracked files under results/ (records the flow itself writes) are listed in untracked_results and do not count

metrics.fmax_basis: minimum per-clock ORFS Fmax when available; aggregate otherwise

netlist_normalization.note: declaration-attribute-only edit on the ORFS-synthesised gate netlist; no cell, net, port or connectivity change

signal_integrity_constraints.basis: explicit SDC signal-integrity constraints this route was repaired against; absent from a record means the SDC carried only set_max_fanout 32 and the liberty files' own max_transition limits
signal_integrity_constraints.hold_corners_basis: ORFS CORNERS: every listed corner's liberty is read as its own scene, so repair_timing fixes setup AND hold at each of them (ASAP7: TC = TT 0.70 V 25 C, BC = FF 0.77 V 0 C, WC = SS 0.63 V 100 C); the platform's multi-bit flop views stay the primary corner's

driver.note: the driver and the sources come from the same tree; git.commit describes both

target_semantics: the target clock period is a characterisation probe, not an operating-point requirement

view.description: ASAP7 7 nm predictive FinFET academic PDK (RVT), as distributed inside the pinned OpenROAD-flow-scripts image.  Predictive view.
view.name: asap7
